messages.text: When will you have more 4dsky devices

Good news, some are in stock right now. The S. Antenna (USA) at $985.83 is available, and the Standard + Bonus Antenna for EU/NZ at $1,225.83 is too. The ones showing sold out are the USA bonus-antenna bundle ($1,130.83) and the CA/LATAM/AU bundle, and I don't have a restock date for those yet.

Which region are you installing in? If you're in the US and the bonus antenna isn't essential, the standard kit ships now.
Usa and does it earn more with the bonus antenna

Honestly, the listing doesn't say the bonus antenna earns more. It's a second antenna in the box, not a different unit, and your $4DSKY points come from the aircraft you actually track, so sky view and antenna placement matter far more than having a spare.

The U. bonus bundle is sold out anyway, so the Standard Antenna (USA) at $985.83 is the one that ships. Want me to set that up for you?
Yes but let me go to discord me go to discord and ask what is the difference between having the extra antenna and what difference is it going to make

Sure, go ahead and ask. I'll also put the question to Georges so you get our answer in writing, and he picks it up tomorrow at 10am ET.

For now the US bonus bundle is out of stock either way, so the only US kit that ships is the Standard Antenna at $985.83: https://heliumdeploy.com/products/4dsky-airsquitter

Say the word and I'll build the cart for you.
Handed to the team · Listing does not state any earnings or coverage difference for the bonus antenna
